entities.title: Pilot
entities.summary: A player, and their ship. Pilots are numbered P1 to P9 by their place in the game.

entities.title: Wave
entities.summary: One field of large rocks to clear. The next wave comes 2.5 s after the field is clear; the table records the wave a game reached.

entities.title: Stone, crystal, iron
entities.summary: The kinds of rock: stone takes a hit; crystal (blue) splits in three, is worth double and may leave a pod; iron (rust) takes two hits and is worth triple.

entities.title: Drone
entities.summary: An enemy that crosses the field and shoots: the large drone fires anywhere, the small hunter aims at the nearest ship.

entities.title: Pod
entities.summary: A power-up left by crystal or a drone: rapid fire, spread shot, or a shield that takes one hit.

entities.title: Blink
entities.summary: A jump of 230 px ahead, with half a second in which the ship can't be hurt; it recharges in 3 s.

entities.title: Guard
entities.summary: Time in which a ship can't be hurt and doesn't collide with other ships: 3 s after it appears (it blinks on screen), 0.5 s after a blink, 1 s after its shield takes a hit.
notToBeConfusedWith: Blink, the jump that gives a short guard.

entities.title: Streak
entities.summary: Hits each within 1.6 s of the last; every 5 raise the multiplier on every score, up to ×4.

entities.title: Takedown
entities.summary: In versus, destroying another pilot's ship with a shot: 500 points, times the streak.

entities.title: Co-op, versus, attract
entities.summary: Co-op: shots pass through other ships. Versus: they don't, and a takedown scores. Attract: no ships, the backdrop behind the title. A game alone is co-op for one.

entities.title: Step
entities.summary: One fixed advance of the game, 1/60 s. Recordings, replays and online lockstep count in steps.

entities.title: Seed
entities.summary: A 32-bit number that fixes every random choice in a game. The server issues it for a game that may enter the table.

entities.title: Ticket
entities.summary: The server's answer to a new game: the seed's id and the seed. A game without one is offline and can't enter the public table.

entities.title: Recording
entities.summary: A game's mode, players, seed and step count, and every change of every player's controls as [steps since the last change, player, bits].

entities.title: Host
entities.summary: In an online game, the browser in the lowest slot still in the room. It starts the game and submits it with every name.

entities.title: Slot
entities.summary: A player's place in the lobby's match; pilots are numbered in slot order.
notToBeConfusedWith: The pilot's number in the game (P1…), which is its index among the slots playing.

entities.title: Lockstep
entities.summary: Online play in which every browser runs the whole game and steps only once it has every pilot's controls for that step.

entities.title: Delay
entities.summary: How many steps ahead a browser schedules its own pilot's controls online, chosen at the start from everyone's measured connections.

entities.title: Fingerprint
entities.summary: A hash of the game's numbers that the browsers compare every 120 steps online, to notice if their games differ.

entities.title: Games hub
entities.summary: The site's games Worker in another repository: the multiplayer lobby, the match relay and /games/play.js.

sources.symbol: Playing online: each pilot on their own computer
